title: Versions made ahead, by the operator's choice
description: Serves "Storage stays bounded."; "Play starts in seconds and keeps up.". D-120. When and how they are made is the design's choice (D-125).
acceptanceCriteria: Off by default; configuration names the qualities and which titles.
They are kept within a share of the budget the operator sets, are never evicted by on-demand work, and stop being made when the share is full, saying so.
Making them never slows anything a viewer or the operator is waiting for, and yields at once to a viewer's job.
A version made ahead is served exactly as the same version made on request.
Storage is shown per version and title, on local disk and S3.
